page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a vertical label "IESVITARVM" runs up the left margin. Head: page number left and running head centred.

main_text.l: Falsa doctrina]Posteriorībus temporibus de-sciscent quidam à fide, spiritibus deceptoribus
attendentes ac doctrinis dæmoniorum per hy-
matrimonium, iubentiū abstinere à cibis, quos
Deus creauit ad participandum cum gratia-
rum actione fidelibus & iis qui cognouerunt
neque accedit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri
Iesu Christi, & ei quæ secundum pietatem est
doctrinæ;is turget, nihil sciens, sed infaniés cir-
ca quæstiones ac verborum pugnas ex quibus
corruptorū, & qui priuati sunt veritate, & quæ-
Inanis gloriatio] Auersare profanos de rebus
inter ceteros omnes sophistæ?] præ se ferentes, circa
Profani clamores ] Profanos de rebus inanibus clamores cohibe: ad maiorem enim proce-dent impietatem. 2.Tim.2,16.

page.notes: The vertical label "IESVITARVM" in the left margin is treated as a margin note, placed in the first paragraph. "iubentiū" and "infaniés" are copied as printed; the macron and the letter forms are not fully certain. "sophistæ" in the bracketed phrase is partly obscured by a stain and is marked [?]. Headings XLV to XLIX are bare numbers and so are written as paragraphs. The paragraph headings "Falsa doctrina", "Infania" and similar are run-in italic words and are kept as paragraph openings.
